report:
Re: [debezium] Debezium xstream skipping tables

Hi all,
        We are currently working on configuring a CDC setup that
        involves Oracle, Pulsar. On the Oracle side, we have implemented
        the setup using the XStream API, and from the Pulsar side, we
        have established a connection using the Debezium connector.
        However, we are encountering an issue with the Debezium
        connector when connecting to the XStream API Outbound server.
        While Oracle is sending the data, Debezium is receiving it, but
        it is skipping without inserting into the Pulsar Topic.
      https://github.com/debezium/debezium/blob/main/debezium-connector-oracle/src/main/java/io/debezium/connector/oracle/xstream/LcrEventHandler.java
      Please find the attached debezium connector config, error
        information.
      --

      Groups "debezium" group.

      send an email to debezium+u...@googlegroups.com.

evidence.quote: I suspect the Debezium user does not have proper access to this table." Reporter: "You're right; I overlooked granting the Debezium user proper select permissions

notes: XStream LCRs received but events skipped; cause was missing SELECT grant for the connector user. Code in LcrEventHandler shows why events for unreadable tables are dropped.

reviews.fix: Grant the Debezium database user SELECT permission on the captured Oracle table.
reviews.evidence: Shyam Sundar Varre: "You're right; I overlooked granting the Debezium user proper select permissions on the table."

reviews.fix: Grant the Debezium database user SELECT permission on the skipped table.
reviews.evidence: Chris Cranford: "I suspect the Debezium user does not have proper access to this table"; reporter: "I overlooked granting the Debezium user proper select permissions on the table."
reviews.boundary: B vs C: the fix is a grant in the Oracle database the operator manages, not a connector setting, so C.
